page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing dedicated CPU allocation. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor, includes a 35 MB L3 cache, and lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance primarily in the lower tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench register in the bottom 10% to 25% categories. Memory bandwidth read-only tests are also weak, though large block write performance reaches average levels. Cryptographic and compression tasks show poor to weak results, with single-threaded gzip compression and text processing scoring in the bottom 10%. However, Passmark CPU and extended instructions tests achieve average ratings, and LLM inference speeds for a small 135M model are average.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2.xlarge offers a balanced resource density of 4 GB RAM per vCPU, typical of general-purpose hardware classes, but its lower-tier benchmark results suggest a tradeoff where compute-heavy tasks will experience reduced throughput per resource unit. Given the lack of local storage and weak database and Redis benchmark scores, this instance is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, or small-scale application hosting that does not require high-performance computing or high-speed local disk I/O.
